reading: This sketch builds a hotel-search results page: a dark top bar with a location/date/guests search bar and a highlighted Search button, a left filter panel with price-range and checkbox groups, a large column of three hotel result cards, a map panel on the right with four price pills, and a small calendar popover above the filter panel for picking dates.
